name: AppDaemon
short_desc: Python apps and HADashboard for Home Assistant
author: AppDaemon
description: AppDaemon is a loosely coupled, multi-threaded, sandboxed Python execution environment for writing automation apps for Home Assistant and other home automation software. It also ships HADashboard, a dashboard system for wall-mounted tablets.

form_fields.label: Home Assistant URL
form_fields.hint: Base URL of your Home Assistant instance.

form_fields.label: Long-Lived Access Token
form_fields.hint: Create one in Home Assistant under Profile > Security.
